# Task 3 BLOCKED: evidence-backed drafted-row amendment under a standing grant

## 0. Observation and classification

```text
wave <w> task 3 BLOCKED report <REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-task3.md patch <none>
```

The structured `question` already carries the evidence, so I skip the direct report read. The evidence is:

- `src/frame.ts:18 - if (kind === HEARTBEAT) return true`
- assertion `expected heartbeat allowed, got rejected`

**Classification:** this is an amend, not a redraw and not a decision.

- It changes the text of an approved **drafted** AC row.
- The correction is backed by quoted implementer evidence: a code line plus an assertion.
- No row is added or removed.
- The problem statement and component boundaries are unchanged.

The amendment route runs before the takeable-decision ladder. Task 3 stays `in_progress`.

## 1. Prepare (writes nothing)

```ts
subagent({ async: false, context: "fresh", cwd: "<abs home worktree>",
  chain: [{ parallel: [
    { agent: "plan-writer", as: "amend_prepare",
      output: "<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-amend-prepare.md", outputMode: "file-only",
      outputSchema: PREPARE_SCHEMA,
      task: `Amend-prepare:
Do not edit any file.
Worktree: <abs home worktree>; Spec: <abs home spec>; Plan: <abs plan>; Plan skill: <abs skills/writing-plans/SKILL.md>; Plan contract: <abs writing-plans plan contract>; Surface: <abs skills/brainstorming/reference/amendment-surface.md>
Trigger: Task 3 (Frame parser) BLOCKED.
Evidence (verbatim from structured question): src/frame.ts:18 - if (kind === HEARTBEAT) return true; assertion: expected heartbeat allowed, got rejected.
Candidate: correct the same drafted AC row "Reject all empty frames" -> "Reject empty payload frames; permit the existing heartbeat marker" (recommended accept).
Return items[] and redraws[] (both arrays, empty when none); one paragraph per edit.` }
  ], stopOn: { path: "/status", in: ["BLOCKED"] } }]
})
```

I consume only the structured JSON. The parent checks `redraws` first, and the expected value is `[]`. Any nonempty value would hold the whole batch.

The expected `items` content is one entry with `recommended: "accept"` and `location: "Acceptance criteria"`.

## 2. Grant read (delegated answer/evidence)

```ts
subagent({ async: false, context: "fresh", cwd: "<abs home worktree>",
  chain: [{ parallel: [
    { agent: "delegate", as: "grant_read",
      output: "<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-grant.md", outputMode: "file-only", outputSchema: ANSWER_SCHEMA,
      task: "Read the **Amend-grant:** line in the header block of <abs home spec>; apply the Standing grants predicate and Value decoding in <abs .../amendment-surface.md>. Answer: malformed | none | active (amend permission yes/no, budget N or none), quoting the line as evidence." }
  ], stopOn: { path: "/status", in: ["BLOCKED"] } }]
})
```

The fixed observation is the line `auto-apply amends`. It has no budget token, and the remainder is non-empty, so it grants **amend permission** with no funding.

Under that grant, I apply the recommended choice in this same turn with no reviewer, no menu and no confirmation.

## 3. In-flight list, then apply

```bash
git -C "<abs home worktree>" status --porcelain
```

The worktree-relative paths it prints become `In-flight:`, together with the spec and plan. I do not commit, restore or discard staged repairs.

```ts
subagent({ async: false, context: "fresh", cwd: "<abs home worktree>",
  chain: [{ parallel: [
    { agent: "plan-writer", as: "amend_apply",
      output: "<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-amend-apply.md", outputMode: "file-only", outputSchema: APPLY_SCHEMA,
      task: `Amend-apply:
<granted item verbatim from items[0]: evidence | recommended: accept | location: Acceptance criteria | edit: "Reject all empty frames" -> "Reject empty payload frames; permit the existing heartbeat marker">
Amend: amended sections = Acceptance criteria (drafted row text correction; row identity preserved). Preserve every task title and wave position the amendment does not touch; edit only affected anchors and tasks; implement-local patching, historical Baseline policy.
In-flight: <spec path>, <plan path>, <paths from status --porcelain>
Before any edit read both committed originals: git -C "<abs home worktree>" show HEAD:<home-relative spec> and HEAD:<home-relative plan>; compute tasksAnchorChanged semantically against them.
Paths: <five absolute paths as above>` }
  ], stopOn: { path: "/status", in: ["BLOCKED"] } }]
})
```

The observation is `passed: true`. I hold `amendedSections`, `tasksAdded`, `tasksAnchorChanged` and `tasksRemoved` as returned; I do not invent their values.

## 4. Parent check and tracker reconciliation

```ts
plan_check({ planPath: "<abs plan>" })
```

The observation is PASS, so I replace the manifest and then reconcile the tracker:

- `plan_tracker` `add` for each index in `tasksAdded`.
- `update` each completed index in `tasksAnchorChanged` to `in_progress`. Task 3 is already `in_progress`.
- Handle `tasksRemoved` through the surface's removal rule.

I print:

```text
amended the spec: Heartbeat marker permitted - Acceptance criteria row "Reject all empty frames" now reads "Reject empty payload frames; permit the existing heartbeat marker"
took recommendation: a for task 3
```

## 5. Single granted audit commit

```bash
printf '%s\n' \
'amend: 1 item(s) - Heartbeat marker permitted' \
'' \
'- heartbeat | Heartbeat marker permitted | Drafted AC row now rejects empty payload frames and permits the existing heartbeat marker | granted | standing grant, no reviewer | src/frame.ts:18 - if (kind === HEARTBEAT) return true; assertion: expected heartbeat allowed, got rejected' \
'"auto-apply amends"' \
| git -C "<abs home worktree>" commit -q -F - -- "<home-relative spec path>" "<home-relative plan path>"
```

This path-scoped commit includes only the spec and plan; staged in-flight repairs are left untouched.

**Boundary reached.** The next operation, not executed here, is the transition-table re-dispatch of task 3's retained payload under `## Answer to your BLOCKED question`, which counts `failed[3] += 1`.

---

## Negative controls (each replaces the setup)

None of these auto-apply, even under `auto-apply amends`. Each is a **redraw**: it is detected at batch preparation as a nonempty `redraws[]`, which holds the whole batch before grant evaluation. No apply, revalidation or further plan-writer dispatch is issued, and the grant never covers it.

| Variant | Why it is a redraw |
|---|---|
| Row originates in the ticket | Ticket rows are excluded from amend items and need a re-draft and the full gate. |
| Only reviewer taste supports it, with no implementer evidence | Reviewer-only or taste objections are redraws; the evidence predicate fails. |
| Add or remove a row | Row add/remove is a redraw. |
| Change the problem statement | This meets the redraw test. |
| Add a component or alter a boundary | This meets the redraw test. |

In every case I stop with a `gauntlet: question` stop note ending in `Recommendation: <option> - <why>`. Task 3 stays `in_progress` and the phase stays `implement`.

The human then takes the brainstorming redraw path, which re-drafts and re-ratifies at the full gate. Redraw expectations under a grant are unchanged.
